why_trail.why: Handoff complete on all seven fields; seam premise reproduced at source; the two shipped modules read end to end.

Adversarial fixture found a REAL defect the handoff did not predict: durable_root() returns its start argument UNCHANGED on every fallback path, so handing it the spine directory (not the repo root) double-nests LESSONS.md. Fixed by resolving durable from repo_root().

emit_step_manifest builds via build_manifest, writes via manifest_path/write_manifest, and returns early when the destination exists so the snapshot is never rewritten. base_dir=None writes nothing, which keeps in-process engine calls from scattering manifests.

reopen() wired identically to start(): emit_step_manifest(cl, iid, base_dir) immediately after t['status']='in-progress', so active_id() selects the reopened gate. DISCLOSURE for the reviewer: the engine diff is the import shim + the two emit calls PLUS two lines of pure plumbing -- reopen() gained a 'base_dir: Path | None = None' kwarg and _run_verb passes it. reopen() had NO other route to the checklist's location, and the alternatives were worse: a module global (hidden state) or emitting from dispatch() (explicitly excluded by the handoff). No logic entered the engine; all logic stays in episode_capture.py.

Exit codes proven UNCHANGED, not merely observed: ran all three named cases (plus a malformed declaration and a reopen) against the pre-seam engine extracted from 967493c AND the wired engine, side by side -- 10/10 identical (terminal checklist: current 0, start 1, advance 1; unmapped root: 0; non-git dir: 0). A failed emit leaves a real stub: the unmapped-root case writes {step: g1, files: null, emit_error: {error: DeclarationError, message: unknown root token 'vendor'...}} while the verb still exits 0 with empty stderr. files: null vs files: [] is now pinned directly, including the trap that both are falsy so a truthiness check would conflate them.

Full suite green: 1435 passed, 2 skipped, 409 subtests in 69.78s. Every required evidence item is pasted, not summarized: the three resolved root tokens from a real py-3.12 run; a real start-produced manifest whose durable row (.agent-work/LESSONS.md) carries a NON-NULL rev, which is the discriminator proving the double-nesting trap is disarmed rather than merely avoided; the write-if-absent before/after (identical sha256 AND identical mtime_ns across a real reopen with the declaration swapped underneath, still naming the original three paths); and the fail-soft exit codes run side by side against the pre-seam engine extracted from 967493c, 10/10 SAME. Two new tests were mutation-checked rather than trusted for passing on first run. Committed at b12e59d.
